/credentialSubject/hasClaim/location: {'id': 'urn:epass:location:' + uuid(), 'type': 'Location', 'description': input.?location, 'address': {'id': 'urn:epass:address:' + uuid(), 'type': 'Address', 'countryCode': vocab.country[input.country.en], 'fullAddress': {'id': 'urn:epass:note:' + uuid(), 'type': 'Note', 'noteLiteral': input.address}}}
/credentialSubject/hasClaim/temporal: has(input.startDate) || has(input.endDate) ? optional.of({'id': 'urn:epass:periodOfTime:' + uuid(), 'type': 'PeriodOfTime', 'startDate': input.?startDate, 'endDate': input.?endDate}) : optional.none()
